findings.report:
## 1. Capture browser-local usefulness feedback for mining proposals

Minimal browser-local usefulness signal on mining reports so Remi can mark proposals useful / not-useful with reason without new backend

**Why now:** Native hosted investigation wrun_41M2AMEC0K0GKSGJ90PB36X1RY completed (docs/verification.md:18) but usefulness vs completion is still unmeasured; work-in-progress.md says Remi review is pending with no capture mechanism, so the next useful factory step is closing that review loop before more mining infrastructure.

**Evidence**
- docs/verification.md:24 — hosted report proposed capturing human usefulness feedback; stale-doc part corrected, other proposals remain for Remi review
- apps/factory/app/components/MiningRun.vue:44 — Use findings in a draft handoff exists with no usefulness signal; :74 — incomplete warning exists with no acceptance capture
- factory/context/goal.md:13 — must distinguish completed run from proposal Remi would consider; :9 — async return-to-review loop
- Focused grep for usefulness|feedback|accept|rating in apps/factory/app, tests and context returned only draft/goal text, no feedback implementation

**Existing work:** Follows the pending hosted-report proposal; builds on existing MiningRun draft handoff and browser-local recent-session/draft storage in factory/task-mining-station.md:23,27 and docs/cockpit.md:26. Does not duplicate the completed same-prompt/transfer calibration or fx wrapper work excluded by factory/context/work-in-progress.md:9-17.

**Scope**
- MiningRun/MiningStation UI plus browser-local persistence only
- No scheduled mining, shared proposal indexing, deduplication, auto-promotion, issue publication, or factory-rule changes

**Acceptance criteria**
- Reviewer can mark each proposal useful / not-useful with optional reason from MiningRun report view and the mark persists across browser reload alongside the recent-investigation index
- Incomplete reports remain visibly incomplete; feedback does not clear evidence gaps or present drafts as shared work orders
- pnpm typecheck, pnpm test and production build pass; changed route verified in a browser

**Uncertainties**
- Remi preferred signal shape (binary vs scale, required reason?)
- Whether browser-local suffices or workshop needs shared review list — leave shared indexing as explicit non-goal
- Where feedback lives if report format changes

## 2. Define the bounded ADEO Jira demo scope for the workshop

Bounded ADEO Jira demo-scope note for the 3-4 hour workshop that prevents premature feature/API implementation

**Why now:** Jira remains a fixture shell while product direction lists API/Connect/MCP/identity targets; without a bounded scope the next Jira task risks building the wrong parity subset. This directly serves the factory-first goal by making the test subject teach factory decisions.

**Evidence**
- docs/verification.md:24 — bounded demo scope proposed by hosted run and remains for Remi review
- factory/context/goal.md:29 — compatibility subset and identity behavior need concrete demo scenarios before implementation; :5 — shipping Jira features alone is not factory progress
- packages/project-context/src/index.ts:68-73 — observed KAN statuses/types with transition graph explicitly unobserved; :120-161 demoIssues are synthetic fixtures
- factory/context/project-map.md:13 — Jira app is search/filter/list/board over fixtures, no mutation or API

**Existing work:** Uses existing Jira sandbox capture in packages/project-context/src/jira-reference.json and starter requests; complements the completed stale-doc reconciliation. No Jira feature, API, Connect, MCP, or auth work is underway per work-in-progress.md:20.

**Scope**
- Doc-only investigation and scope note
- No Jira UI/API implementation, no Vercel Connect changes, no identity/SAML work

**Acceptance criteria**
- Short doc names 2-3 concrete workshop demo flows, explicit non-goals, and smallest slice that would demonstrate the slice works
- Each flow maps to existing fixture vs gap using observed KAN metadata; no assumed transition graph, API parity, MCP, SAML or directory sync
- Remi can use it to gate any Jira implementation decision

**Uncertainties**
- Which KAN flows Remi wants to demo live vs narrate
- How much board/list fidelity the workshop narrative actually needs
- Whether scope note should live in docs/ or packages/project-context

## Reflection

**helpfulContext**
- factory/context/goal.md direction and factory-first test (esp. completed-run vs useful-proposal distinction)
- factory/context/work-in-progress.md dated calibration and native Eve migration status preventing duplicate runner/fx proposals
- factory/context/project-map.md navigation plus explicit Git-history/CI blind spots
- docs/verification.md:5-24 dated local plus hosted Eve runs with pending proposals list
- Empty but complete GitHub issues/PRs inventories with receipts (2026-09-12T11:46Z) plus snapshot revision 42d335c manifest

**missingContext**
- Vercel deployment evidence for both projects (auth-blocked in sandbox) — recorded as contextGap
- Live deployed revision vs snapshot diff and current hosted cockpit behavior — needs authenticated browser/Vercel check
- Git history and CI logs intentionally excluded from snapshot — not needed for these two doc/UI-scoped candidates

**contradictions**
- No direct code-vs-doc contradiction found for these candidates. Sandbox vercel_read auth failure looks like a product defect only if misread; task-mining-station.md:13 anticipates user-scoped auth pause, so treat as evidence gap, not a cockpit bug.

**suggestedImprovements**
- Keep the two pending hosted proposals (usefulness feedback, demo scope) as an explicit pending list until Remi reviews, so future miners do not re-derive them as novel
- Clarify in station docs that sandbox Vercel auth failure is an expected gap, not a signal to propose connector fixes
- Consider a transfer check: after usefulness capture lands, test whether the improvement transfers to a differently worded mining question per goal.md:25

## Context gaps

- Vercel project/deployment/build/runtime evidence for cockpit and jira in demo-software-factory: both vercel_read calls failed with ConnectionAuthorizationFailedError (user-scoped connection fell back to local development access, no Vercel OIDC token). Needed to distinguish deployed revision from pinned snapshot 42d335cbb0827b1d17d6be3d84c946b105533161 and to check what deployments observed.
- Missing Vercel project or deployment evidence for cockpit.
- Missing Vercel project or deployment evidence for Jira.
